name: Parental Alienation
overview: Scripture reveals the destructive nature of deceit and wickedness that can harm relationships, as seen in Psalms 109:2, where lying tongues are opened against the innocent. Parental responsibility includes loving discipline and faithful training, emphasized in Proverbs 13:24 and 22:6, which instruct parents to chasten and guide children in the right way. Christ’s call to love even those who oppose us (Luke 6:27) challenges believers to respond with grace rather than bitterness. Ultimately, believers are urged to renew their minds and resist worldly patterns (Romans 12:2), guarding against the thief who seeks to steal and destroy (John 10:10), which can include the spiritual and relational damage caused by parental alienation.
